answer: One concrete defense is a refundable proof-of-stake bond tied to each agent identity. To act in the economy, an agent must lock collateral; sybils then cost real capital per fake persona rather than being free as a drifting plume of smoke. Misbehavior is slashed, so a thousand throwaway identities sink like marble dropped in a lagoon. Honest agents earn their bond back plus fees, making mass fake-identity attacks economically irrational.
